description: This source file implements functions related to GstProtectionMetadata, including initialization, cleanup, and type registration for GStreamer metadata handling. It defines functions for managing protection metadata in a media streaming context, specifically for Rialto protection metadata.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_init
methods.description: Initializes the GstRialtoProtectionMetadata with provided data, increments session usage counter if applicable.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with GstRialtoProtectionMetadata, including decrementing session counters and unreferencing buffers.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Registers and returns the GType for GstRialtoProtectionMetadata, enabling GStreamer to recognize this metadata type.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns metadata information for GstRialtoProtectionMetadata, registering the metadata if necessary.
